SurveyProject.title: SurveyProject
SurveyProject.description: User land survey project containing calculations, traverse sheets, and polygon measurements.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner surveyor.

name.description: Name or title of the survey parcel / project.

state.description: Indian state of survey jurisdiction (e.g. Andhra Pradesh, Telangana).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string of creation.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp string of update.

traverse.description: Closed traverse station records, Bowditch adjustment, and closing error.

notes.description: Field notes, village boundary, or surveyor remarks.

MarketListing.title: MarketListing
MarketListing.description: Verified land / plot listing for sale published by a verified surveyor or owner.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the publisher.

state.description: Indian State where the plot is located.

surveyNo.description: Official Revenue Survey Number or LP Number.

boundaryGeoJson.description: Stringified GeoJSON feature of the surveyed polygon boundary.

verified.description: Whether this plot has been survey-verified.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile with authoritative role and account status.

DeveloperInvitation.title: DeveloperInvitation
DeveloperInvitation.description: Owner invitation for technical administrators with secure tokens.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable audit record of sensitive administrative actions.

SystemSetting.title: SystemSetting
SystemSetting.description: System-wide announcements and operational feature flags.

BugReport.title: BugReport
BugReport.description: User-reported issue or defect triaged by Developers and Owner.

PrivateSellerData.title: PrivateSellerData
PrivateSellerData.description: Sensitive seller contact and identity information protected from public queries.

/survey_projects/{projectId}.description: Private survey projects collection accessible only by the owner userId.

/market_listings/{listingId}.description: Publicly readable marketplace listings for verified plots, writable only by owner userId.

/market_seller_data/{listingId}.description: Protected private seller contact and identity records accessible strictly to the listing owner and Super Admin Owner.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles with role and status, writable only by authorized admin or self (non-role fields).

/developer_invitations/{invitationId}.description: Developer invitations managed exclusively by the Super Admin Owner.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable security and administrative audit trail accessible only to Owner.

/system_settings/{settingId}.description: System-wide announcement banners and feature flags.

/bug_reports/{reportId}.description: User bug reports accessible to creator, Developers, and Owner.
